editor.defaultBody: Knowledge compounds when it is written down and shared. Write in **Markdown**, drop in HTML, and use emoji freely. > A tiny paper is enough — one clear idea, carefully told. ![Morning light over open water](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1470071459604-3b5ec3a7fe05?w=1400)

profile.title: You
profile.subtitle: Your profile and public booking details
profile.mastheadSubtitle: The quiet byline behind the knowledge you share.
profile.bannerUrlDescription: Link to your header / cover image (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF).
profile.bioPlaceholder: I write about the open web and careful systems.
profile.solidDescription: Sign in with your WebID. Published notes are saved as Markdown files in your Pod.
profile.solidIdentityProviderDescription: Inrupt, solidcommunity.net, or your own Solid-OIDC issuer.
profile.solidPodRootDescription: Leave blank to auto-detect storage from your WebID profile.
profile.fediDescription: Connect your running FediPod agent — a personal ActivityPub server backed by your Solid Pod. Ailo reads your home timeline and shares stories to the Fediverse.
profile.fediCreatorDescription: Adds a fediverse_creator marker to published Markdown. Your site template must emit the HTML tag below for Mastodon to see it.
profile.fediCreatorTagFootnote: Paste this into each article’s HTML head. Attribution is accepted only from an allowed domain configured on your federated profile.
profile.fediCreatorDomainsDescription: One domain per line. A domain also permits its subdomains; paths and URLs are rejected.
profile.fediUrlDescription: Where your FediPod agent is running. Default is http://localhost:8030.
profile.fediPasswordDescription: This FediPod instance has a UI password set — enter it to authorize.
profile.fediLoginOAuthNotePrefix: Ailo authorizes itself against the agent’s
profile.fediLoginOAuthNoteSuffix: endpoint, the same way Phanpy or Tuba do. Nothing to copy — this only works while FediPod is reachable at the URL above.
profile.fediManualTokenToggle: Or paste an access token manually
profile.fediTokenDescription: A Mastodon-compatible access token from your FediPod instance.
profile.fediPasswordRequired: This FediPod instance needs its agent password to authorize login.
profile.githubDescription: Create or choose a repository. Each published note becomes a Markdown commit.
profile.calDescription: Let readers book a session to keep the conversation going. Paste your Cal.com username or event path.
profile.calPathDescription: Examples: “ada” or “ada/30min” or a full cal.com URL.
profile.calEmbedEmpty: Add a Cal.com path to embed your scheduler here.

tags.followedDescription: Public posts using these hashtags are added to your home timeline by FediPod.
tags.featuredDescription: Show up to ten hashtags on your fediverse profile. Counts reflect your own posts.

customFeedEditor.rulesNote: Matches any included rule. Exclusions always win.
customFeedEditor.draftNote: Only this request is sent to your provider. Rules stay editable, and post matching remains on-device.
customFeedEditor.peopleNote: One @person@server per line. This does not follow them.
customFeedEditor.hashtagsNote: One tag per line, with or without #.
customFeedEditor.topicsNote: One topic per line. Exact phrase matches appear immediately; similar meaning is matched locally.

moderation.summaryNoProvider: Connect an OpenAI or Gemini key on Provider Keys to get a written recap here each week.
moderation.contentBlockedDetail: {{filtered}} hidden by filters, {{intake}} kept from reaching you · {{trend}}
moderation.statsError: Could not load this week’s moderation stats.
moderation.blockedDomainsNote: Hide posts from a domain and all of its subdomains across home, hashtag, list, and custom feeds.
moderation.filtersDescription: Match exact text, hashtags, whole words, or phrases—several per filter—and posts with the same meaning. EmbeddingGemma analysis runs locally. Its approximately 230 MB model downloads and caches when you add your first filter.
moderation.keywordsNote: One keyword or phrase per line — any of them matches this filter.

translation.providerDescription: Choose which backend translates Fediverse posts.
translation.autoNote: Use the first configured translation provider.
translation.openaiNote: Use the configured OpenAI model for translation.
translation.geminiNote: Use the configured Gemini model for translation.
translation.libreUrlDescription: Use HTTPS for remote servers. HTTP is accepted only for localhost self-hosting.
translation.targetLanguageDescription: Used by both the Translate button and auto-translation.
translation.autoTranslateDescription: Automatically show translations for short timeline posts without a content warning, sensitive media, attachments, article preview, or filters.
translation.autoTranslatePrivacyNote: Privacy note: eligible post text is sent automatically to your selected translation provider. This is on by default while a provider is configured, and you can turn it off here.
translation.providerKeysNote: DeepL and hosted LibreTranslate keys are entered on Provider Keys. A self-hosted LibreTranslate server may not require one.
